name: redis
description: Redis is an open source (BSD licensed), in-memory data structure store, used as a database, cache and message broker. Based on official Redis Docker image. You must create the config file first located at /mnt/user/appdata/redis/conf/redis.conf. See following link to get the files https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/oss_and_stack/management/config/ If you want to use redis-full.conf, you must change the "Post Arguments" accordingly and refer to https://hub.docker.com/_/redis There's currently a bug with the template the path for /config isn't properly set. It must be /mnt/user/appdata/redis/conf/ Be sure to chmod to nobody:users the appdata folder and all files.
